svg.title: Commit First, Purchase Second, Reconcile Through Settlement
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-commitment-to-cleared-cash; chart type: process_flow; title: Commit First, Purchase Second, Reconcile Through Settlement; subtitle: Five operating steps connect authorized inventory to cleared cash.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Buying-group orders and ticket allocations use separate evidence records. Net-3 and Net-5 are negotiated counterparty terms, not assured clearing dates. A 60-day ledger horizon does not create a contractual 60-day interest-free card period.; caption: The purchase-order reconciler links commitment, purchase, delivery, receivable and card obligation before an operator increases exposure.; stages: label: Document the commitment; value: Signed terms before any purchasing commitment; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record the vetted buying group's accepted SKU, quantity, reimbursement, acceptance criteria and Net-3 or Net-5 trigger. For tickets, verify allocation ownership and transfer rights.; label: Reserve cash and limits; value: Cash coverage before card authorization occurs; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Reserve full card repayment independently of expected ACH receipts. Verify issuer category eligibility, rebate exclusions, available limits and the actual statement due date.; label: Acquire through authorized channels; value: Permitted purchases with retained acquisition evidence; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use ordinary merchant checkout or authorized allocation contracts. Preserve receipts and purchase limits; prohibit queue or CAPTCHA bypass and credential sharing.; label: Deliver and evidence acceptance; value: Tracked delivery tied to each receivable; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Insure high-value merchandise and retain serial numbers, carrier acceptance and signed delivery evidence. Record ticket transfers and synchronize SkyBox or Automatiq listings.; label: Clear and reconcile; value: Cleared receipts matched against card liabilities; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match bank-cleared ACH, exchange payouts, fees and issuer rebates to each order. Pay the card on time even when a buying group delays reimbursement.

text.title: Commit First, Purchase Second, Reconcile Through Settlement
text.tspan: Commit First, Purchase Second, Reconcile Through

rect.title: label: Document the commitment; value: Signed terms before any purchasing commitment; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record the vetted buying group's accepted SKU, quantity, reimbursement, acceptance criteria and Net-3 or Net-5 trigger. For tickets, verify allocation ownership and transfer rights.

text.title: Record the vetted buying group's accepted SKU, quantity, reimbursement, acceptance criteria and Net-3 or Net-5 trigger. For tickets, verify allocation ownership and transfer rights.

rect.title: label: Reserve cash and limits; value: Cash coverage before card authorization occurs; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Reserve full card repayment independently of expected ACH receipts. Verify issuer category eligibility, rebate exclusions, available limits and the actual statement due date.

text.title: Reserve full card repayment independently of expected ACH receipts. Verify issuer category eligibility, rebate exclusions, available limits and the actual statement due date.

rect.title: label: Acquire through authorized channels; value: Permitted purchases with retained acquisition evidence; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use ordinary merchant checkout or authorized allocation contracts. Preserve receipts and purchase limits; prohibit queue or CAPTCHA bypass and credential sharing.

text.title: Use ordinary merchant checkout or authorized allocation contracts. Preserve receipts and purchase limits; prohibit queue or CAPTCHA bypass and credential sharing.

rect.title: label: Deliver and evidence acceptance; value: Tracked delivery tied to each receivable; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Insure high-value merchandise and retain serial numbers, carrier acceptance and signed delivery evidence. Record ticket transfers and synchronize SkyBox or Automatiq listings.

text.title: Insure high-value merchandise and retain serial numbers, carrier acceptance and signed delivery evidence. Record ticket transfers and synchronize SkyBox or Automatiq listings.

rect.title: label: Clear and reconcile; value: Cleared receipts matched against card liabilities; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match bank-cleared ACH, exchange payouts, fees and issuer rebates to each order. Pay the card on time even when a buying group delays reimbursement.

text.title: Match bank-cleared ACH, exchange payouts, fees and issuer rebates to each order. Pay the card on time even when a buying group delays reimbursement.

Assumptions: Buying-group orders and ticket allocations use separate evidence records. Net-3 and Net-5 are negotiated counterparty terms, not assured clearing dates. A 60-day ledger horizon does not create a contractual 60-day interest-free card period.
